clearCache.explain: The saved copy of the catalog in this browser no longer matches the store’s signed catalog, so it can’t be trusted and Retry will keep failing. Clearing it downloads a fresh, verified copy. Your browsing history and the search model stay on this device.
clearCache.rollbackWarning: The store’s server offered an older catalog than the one you already have. That can mean someone is tampering with it. Only clear if you trust this — clearing makes this browser accept the catalog it is offered next.
